missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Пастух' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'пасёт'. 'Старый' is the agreeing masculine adjective. 'Овец' is the genitive plural object.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Пастуха' takes the genitive-like ending because the noun is animate masculine, so accusative equals genitive. 'На холме' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Пастуха' is genitive after 'у', naming the possessor. 'Собака' is the nominative subject of 'была'. A natural possession frame.
Strategic focus: Dative after помогать. 'Пастуху' is dative, the indirect object required by 'помогает'. A core dative-verb pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after за. 'Пастухом' is instrumental, governed by 'за' meaning behind or after. Describes following someone. A useful motion pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Пастухе' is the prepositional form after 'о', naming the topic of talk. 'Старом' agrees in the masculine prepositional. A discussion pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Пастух' is nominative as the subject of 'поёт'. 'Песню' is the accusative object and 'тихую' agrees with it. A peaceful scene.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Пастуху' is dative, the recipient of 'дали'. 'Воды' is partitive genitive meaning some water. A core giving pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Пастухи' is the nominative plural subject of 'живут'. 'Опытные' agrees in the plural. Practises the plural form.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Пастухов' takes the genitive plural ending because the noun is animate, so accusative equals genitive in the plural too. 'На лугу' gives the location.
